Template filter requires 580.178.04 exactly; the template was applied to this offer by hash via the CLI, so the filter did not apply.
The instance API key returned at creation is not recorded anywhere in this repository.
No stop schedule yet. Set one before leaving the instance unattended.

Instance C rented 22 October 2026 to run seeds 1 and 2 in parallel with B's seed 0; see progress/01b-lanes.md.

All three instances destroyed by 2026-10-23T00:22 UTC. Replication complete: pooled 12/3/29/34 over 78 against the published 21/4/27/26; both frozen Fisher tests pass (p = 0.116, 0.332). See progress/receipts/01-review.md.
Instance D rented 2026-10-23 06:45 UTC for the seed 0 rerun (todo 1c); destroy after its item 6 lands and the upload is verified.
